cases.question: Compare the amendment's effective date with the original termination clause and explain how the governing statute affects it.

nodes.text: The original agreement permits termination on thirty days notice.
The amendment is effective January 1, 2026 and replaces the termination notice period.
The governing statute requires a minimum sixty day termination notice period.

cases.question: Compare the holdings in Smith and Jones and explain why the later court reached a different result.

nodes.text: Smith held that notice was adequate.
Jones distinguished Smith because the notice omitted a statutory warning.
The statutory warning is mandatory in consumer notices.

cases.question: Compare the agreement with its amendment and explain how the amendment affects liability.

nodes.text: The agreement caps liability at one million dollars.
